annotations.title: What a job pays in a place

description: What a job pays in a place. For "what does a nurse earn in Birmingham", "average salary for a data analyst in Austin", "is £35k good for a junior developer in London". Gives the typical yearly range (middle half of current adverts), the middle figure and the average advertised, from current job adverts. Advertised pay, not offers.

country.description: US or UK when the place exists in both, or a country by name.

what.description: Job title or field, for example "nurse" or "software engineer".

where.description: A city, region, postcode or country, for example Birmingham, Austin, TX or remote.
